name: dnd-tool
description: D&D character sheet and campaign tool
author: JohanGJensen

scripts.start: bun run build && NODE_ENV=production bun server/index.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && vite build
scripts.desktop: bun run build && bun run build:electron && electron .
scripts.desktop:dist: bun run build && bun run build:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.desktop:smoke: bun build scripts/node-smoke.ts --target=node --format=esm --outdir dist-electron && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist-electron/node-smoke.js
